direction: Counterclaim, accounting, reproducibility and reuse audit
strategy: Read benchmark measurement and Pareto plotting code, inspect source figure labels, compare fixed-three versus fixed-five conditions, and challenge exact replay, revenue, Pass@1 and production-service interpretations.
